existing_functional_build_difference: Native/KD cases enable a separately checked downgrade; TCLock rejects it and tests explicit Native fallback. These entire clients are not a matched timing workload.
limits: No full-mm replacement, no generic MM-body delegation and no resolution of mutex regressions

correctness_cases: four readers with one metadata writer
supported_common.fault_context: Originating task; native mmap lock unchanged
supported_common.mapping: MAP_SHARED, PROT_READ, non-executable, no fork inheritance
supported_common.private_read_work: Verify epoch/complement and acquire one backing-page reference
supported_common.private_write_work: Increment epoch and update complement; no allocation, user copy or page-table work

timing_prerequisites: Implement a timed client; current client reports correctness only
Freeze a new timing source revision and per-arm binary hashes; do not time aggregate correctness-run duration
Set features=0 for all common arms; preserve all observation settings and separate Native fallback
Use original recovery VM, snapshot, worker prefix and collector CPU 63; retain strict host checks and failures
Use original two-second windows, three ordered repetitions and retained 300 ms peak/settling and 10 ms sampling settings where applicable
Record exact work, context/ownership checks, per-repeat range/CV, failures and drain before interpreting ratios
Validate any added multiple-writer or cancellation case before timing it
